damageLaw: In the Ice Caves three blows are a KO on a foot soldier whatever his HP (a swordsman's cut, the Ferocious Yeti's landing) or on anyone at all (the falling ice: Sarge, the machines and the heroes too); every other blow is bar hits x the share (90 % + 10 % x bar / HP): a landing, a charge, a fish or the stomp 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 by tier, the chase's run 2, a cut on Sarge, the medic, a machine or a hero 3, the Ferocious Yeti's landing on them 2 · 3 · 4 · 4. King Yeti's and King Rex's hide bounces every cave creature's bar hit (only the ice takes them); the saber Sarge turns about half; a man left alone 4 s mends one bar hit. Difficulty scales the bodies by the raid curve (x1 · 1.5 · 2.2 · 2.64), doubles the bar hits from HARD, deepens the chomp and lengthens the dark; no rung price rides the caves.
headlines: Three blows kill a foot soldier whatever his HP: a swordsman's cut, THE FEROCIOUS YETI's landing (THE CHOMP, 58 px wide) and the falling ice, which kills everyone under it: Sarge of every iron, the jeep, the tank, every hero (measured on every tier, both engines).

Every other blow is bar hits off the one bar every man carries (7 for the men, 6 for the medic, 12 for the saber Sarge) x the share: a cave yeti's landing, a spearman's charge, a fisher's fish and the stomp 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 by tier, the chase's run 2, a cut on Sarge or the medic 3, THE CHOMP on them 2 · 3 · 4 · 4. So the heavies are not heavy here: a flame (51 HP) and a rifleman (22 HP) fall to the same cut, landing and shard, and stand the same 7 landings.

King Yeti and King Rex are the exception the other way: every cave creature's blow bounces off their hide (the whole cave family counts as thrown snow), the falling ice alone takes them (measured: 56 of 56 blows turned per hero over the tiers and engines, both KO'd by the ice every time).

The saber Sarge turns about half of every bar-hit blow (measured 4–7 of 10 landings, 2–8 of 10 cuts, 2–5 of 10 chomps); the kill doors are not his to turn, and he is not a foot soldier: the cut and the chomp take him in bar hits (3 and 2 · 3 · 4 · 4), the ice kills him.
A commando's shield breaks the first falling shard over him or over any man within 120 px of him, his one charge; the second shard kills him (measured on every tier).

His bar is 1080 · 1890 · 1881 · 3089 solo at the lab's levels 45 · 47 · 48 · 50 (450 x 2.4 · 2.8 · 1.9 · 2.6 x the raid curve ×1 · 1.5 · 2.2 · 2.64); a party grows it x(1 + 0.9 a commander past the first): 2052 · 3590 · 3574 · 5868 with two. Under 60 % THE CAVE-IN (the dark, the band of ice 9 · 13 · 16 · 18 s), under 25 % THE CHASE (on the floor for good at 140 · 165 · 190 · 210 px/s).

Difficulty changes the bar hits (1 on EASY and MEDIUM, 2 from HARD), THE CHOMP (2 · 3 · 4 · 4), the bodies (x1 · 1.5 · 2.2 · 2.64), the head-counts (2 · 2 · 3 · 3 cave yetis a burst; 1–4 spearmen, 1–2 fishers, 1–3 swordsmen live), the storm (7 · 6 · 12 · 12 s) and the lab's level; THE RAVAGE is HARD's and MEGA's alone.

bossMoves.name: THE CHOMP
bossMoves.cadence: his landing out of a hole: a 0.55 s flight at the man deepest in your line (every third strike out of the back hole), two eyes lit 0.6 · 0.45 · 0.35 · 0.25 s before; one strike in seven is this alone, four are rampages, two stomps
bossMoves.note: every foot soldier within 58 px of where he lands is KO'd whatever his HP (measured on every tier); Sarge, the medic, the jeep, the tank and a hero take 2 · 3 · 4 · 4 bar hits x the share and a 80 px bowl-over (the saber turns about half: measured 2–5 of 10; King Yeti and King Rex turn every one)
bossMoves.code: updateFoeFyeti 'strike' -> fyLand (FY_LAND_R; DY_FOOT -> knockKill; FY_PIPS -> tanHit)

bossMoves.name: THE RAMPAGE
bossMoves.cadence: four strikes of seven: the landing, then 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 more bounds in a chain at the nearest man within 420 px, 0.42 s a bound
bossMoves.note: each landing KOs the foot soldiers under it and takes 1 · 2 · 3 · 3 bar hits x the share off everyone else (one lighter than the chomp; measured on EASY: the medic took 1, the rifleman beside him fell)
bossMoves.code: fyLand(FY_PIPS - FY_RAMP_PIPS_DN) on the follow-up bounds (FY_RAMP_N, FY_RAMP_R)

bossMoves.name: THE STOMP
bossMoves.cadence: two strikes of seven: he lands, rises 0.35 s (the amber ring), and the shockwave lands
bossMoves.note: 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 bar hits x the share on every man within 150 px and a 130 px bowl-over (measured on every man at 60 px; King Yeti and King Rex turn it)

bossMoves.name: THE FALLING ICE
bossMoves.cadence: from his arrival, every 7 · 6 · 12 · 12 s a volley of 2 · 3 · 2 · 2 clusters of three shadows, each cluster aimed at a man on his feet; a shadow grows 1.8 s, then the shard lands; inside THE CAVE-IN the band's rows instead
bossMoves.note: every unit within 40 px of the shadow is KO'd: Sarge of every iron, the jeep, the tank, every hero (measured on every tier, both engines: a rifleman fell 1 s after the shadow). A pet's shield, Francis's block or the blue wall turns a shard into 3 bar hits; the champion's grace once. A commando's shield breaks the first shard over him or over any man within 120 px of him, his one charge (measured: the rifleman in his circle stood; a second shard over the commando killed him). Wyatt 9/25: the stalagmites destroy just about any unit; THE KO PASS leaves this a kill on his word.
bossMoves.code: fyStorm / hrtBandRow -> caveIcPass -> caveDropHit (FY_ICICLE_R, FY_STORM_WARN; a wall: FY_ICICLE_PIPS -> tanHit; else knockKill); cirCatch (cmdoCharged, ENH_CMDO_GUARD_R)

bossMoves.name: THE CAVE-IN
bossMoves.effect: the dark act: a band of falling ice walks the floor
bossMoves.cadence: once, under 60 % of his bar: he runs for the mouth, the lights go down, the band walks from x 1780 to the toy box in 9 · 13 · 16 · 18 s
bossMoves.note: rows 64 px apart, 8 seats a row down the floor, 50 % · 40 % · 30 % · 25 % of the seats left dark (the gaps a man can stand in); a man the band kills gets x1 · 1 · 0.75 · 0.5 of his price back in all (the caves' purse); each shard is THE FALLING ICE's kill with the storm's 1.8 s tell (measured: a band shard KO'd a rifleman 1.817 s after its shadow); the lights come up at the last march

bossMoves.name: THE RAVAGE
bossMoves.effect: his charges down the hole columns
bossMoves.cadence: HARD and MEGA, under 26 % of his bar, between the cave-in and the chase
bossMoves.note: the column charges from the top holes down and the sweep from the mouth to the back hole, with the swarm (5 · 7 cave yetis on the rail); his contact on the run is the chase's (2 bar hits); not staged on this page (the read's cells)

bossMoves.name: THE CHASE
bossMoves.cadence: under 25 % of his bar: out of the mouth for good, running at a man at 140 · 165 · 190 · 210 px/s; every 6 s a roar calls the raiders to the box and the swordsmen out
bossMoves.note: every man within 40 px of him takes 2 bar hits x the share and a bowl-over every 0.5 s he stays under him (measured on every man and hero; King Yeti and King Rex turn it); his bar is on the floor to shoot the whole way

bossMoves.name: THE FROST BREATH
bossMoves.note: in the file, off the rota: the 330 px cone (1 bar hit and a freeze of 0.7 · 0.9 · 1.3 · 1.6 s) is never dealt in a fight today

bossMoves.name: THE ARRIVAL
bossMoves.effect: He shows himself in the far mouth 25 s into the fight (two eyes in the black, a roar), waits 1.6 s, then vanishes into the holes and the hunt begins.
bossMoves.note: He shows himself in the far mouth 25 s into the fight (two eyes in the black, a roar), waits 1.6 s, then vanishes into the holes and the hunt begins. Before him the holes have already fielded the cave yetis (five bursts from 8 · 6 · 5 · 4 s by tier), the spearmen (16 · 14 · 13 · 12 s), the fishers (21.5 · 19.5 · 18.5 · 17.5 s) and the swordsmen (22 · 20 · 19 · 18 s); the three holes nearest the toy box stay shut till 25 · 20 · 15 · 10 s.

bossMoves.name: THE HUNT
bossMoves.effect: ACT I: between strikes he is in the dark (the tier's share of the dark; HARD and MEGA also hold every man within 300 px of his roar for 1 s).
bossMoves.note: ACT I: between strikes he is in the dark (the tier's share of the dark; HARD and MEGA also hold every man within 300 px of his roar for 1 s). Two ice-blue eyes light in the hole he will come out of for the tier's warn, then he bounds out of the hole nearest the man deepest in your line (every third strike out of THE BACK HOLE behind you), a 0.55 s flight that tracks the man's feet, and lands. The landing is one of three on a seven-strike rota: THE RAMPAGE 4 of 7, THE STOMP 2, a single CHOMP 1.

bossMoves.name: THE GATES
bossMoves.effect: On his bar: THE CAVE-IN under 60 %; on HARD and MEGA THE RAVAGE under 26 %; THE CHASE under 25 %.
bossMoves.note: On his bar: THE CAVE-IN under 60 %; on HARD and MEGA THE RAVAGE under 26 %; THE CHASE under 25 %. Act II's strikes call the cave yetis (2 a wake) and the swordsmen with every strike (Act I: every second).

bossMoves.note: He never marches the box in the hunt: his legs run at your men. The cave yetis do (THE RAIDERS after the first minute, the roar's callers in THE CHASE): a bite costs 1 life.

No rung price rides the caves, so THE BOSS LAB's slider and a real party read the same.

changes.what: A hole's rim steers a man's step, a man pushed across a rim falls in (the pit law), the hand is refused at a rim.

The caves' purse: a cave creature pays its bounty x 4 · 3.6 · 3.2 · 3 dog tags by tier (a cave yeti 40 · 36 · 32 · 30, a swordsman 120 · 108 · 96 · 90; measured as born); a man the cave-in's band kills gets x1 · 1 · 0.75 · 0.5 of his price back in all.
The caves pan down for the hand like the flat rugs, so the bottom row of holes clears the troop tray on a phone.
The quiet start: the first burst at 8 · 6 · 5 · 4 s by tier (was 2.5 everywhere), the three holes nearest the toy box asleep till 25 · 20 · 15 · 10 s, the lab forgets the speed dial on a reload.

+3 HP every tenth rank for the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando (at level 45 to 48: 40 · 37 · 51 · 49 HP; at 50: 49 · 45 · 61 · 58); a bar hit lands a hair lighter on them, the kill doors do not care.
One HP number: a bar hit lands 90 % + 10 % x bar / HP of itself.
The Boss Lab fights the caves with its stock army at level 45 · 47 · 48 · 50.
A party grows his bar (x1 + 0.9 a commander past the first) instead of multiplying him.
His bar re-priced for a fight all on the floor: x2.4 · 2.8 · 1.9 · 2.6 by tier.
A commando's shield breaks a falling shard over him or any man within 120 px, once.
His bar down 20 % on every difficulty (Wyatt 10/3); the fisher throws at a plane nearer than his man.
The pace: the cave-in's band walks its span in 9 · 13 · 16 · 18 s; MEGA's swordsmen 1 a call, 2 live; the roar wakes 2 cave yetis on MEGA.

The hits land: the swordsman's cut downs a foot soldier; the falling ice is aimed at the men. CARD-YF3 the same day: his landing kills the foot soldiers under it (58 px) and the rampage is his default landing. CARD-CF: the storm kills (Wyatt 9/25). CARD-YF4: the storm's pace by tier.

questions.text: The bar question for Raziya: the caves' blows ignore HP (one bar of 7 hits for every man but the medic, Sarge and the commando), so a flame and a rifleman stand the same count of landings, charges and fish, and the heavies are not heavy here. A bar by HP class, or THE KO PASS's HP numbers on the landing, the charge and the fish too? Nothing is proposed on this page (Wyatt 11/1 15:15: ask, propose nothing).

THE CHOMP kills a foot soldier under his landing today (CARD-YF3, Wyatt 9/26: "owning people left and right"). THE KO PASS's rule (Wyatt 11/1 14:17) numbers every strike that KOs today, so the proposal numbers the chomp and the rampage's landings like the swordsman's cut; the falling ice alone stays a kill (his 9/25 word, his 15:15 REC).
questions.rec: the number on the chomp as proposed; say so if the chomp should stay a kill like the ice

questions.text: King Yeti and King Rex take nothing from any cave creature's blow (their hide bounces thrown snow, and the whole cave family counts as snow); only the falling ice takes them. Intended?
questions.rec: a read for Raziya; if the kings should feel the caves, the cave family's snow flag is the one cell

questions.text: A commando's shield breaks the first falling shard over him or over any man within 120 px, then he is spent for the fight; the second shard kills him. Intended as the one roof against the ice?
questions.rec: as is (Wyatt 10/5: the reflect shield negates the falling icicles); a read

questions.text: THE FROST BREATH is in the file but off his rota (never dealt in a fight today); the page and this file list it as off.
questions.rec: keep it off until its animation is drawn (Wyatt 9/26), or retire the cone

questions.text: THE KO PASS: the strikes that KO today would hit for EASY 39 · MEDIUM 39 · HARD 39 · MEGA 48 HP by tier (the lab's level 45 · 47 · 48 · 50), the top of the window EASY 37 to 39 · MEDIUM 37 to 39 · HARD 37 to 39 · MEGA 45 to 48: the hardest hit that leaves every heavy standing, with the weakest (the BAZOOKA everywhere) at 1 HP. The bottom of the window leaves him 2 to 7 HP and lets no lesser man stand either.
questions.rec: the top, as Wyatt framed it (high, not enough to defeat a heavy); say the bottom if the BAZOOKA should keep a cushion.

questions.text: At the proposed hit the lab's Sarge EASY SABER 32: falls · MEDIUM SABER 32: falls · HARD SABER 32: falls · MEGA SABER 35: falls (as today, where the strike takes him), and every hero stands: on EASY the PRINCESS CROAK falls in 2 hits and the KING REX in 5 (today most of these strikes fell a hero in one). Count the Sarge as a heavy and the number drops under his HP, and the M. GUNNER stands with him.
questions.rec: as proposed: the Sarge keeps his saves (the shield, the blade, the Claymore), and a hero who shrugs off a KO strike is what his bar is for; say so if a hero should still fall in one.

questions.text: The number is pinned to the lab's level for the tier: a player who comes in higher has men with 4 to 5 more HP a decade (the heavies 9 to 10), so his lesser men start standing (the M. GUNNER first) while his heavies stand wider.
questions.rec: as is; a card that moves a lab level re-runs this pass with the five kits (one command).

rows.t: A proposal (Nov 1, 2026), nothing in the game has changed. The game fells a man whose HP reaches 0, so a hit equal to his HP fells him and one under it leaves him standing; the three heavies are Wyatt's list; HP is each man's at the lab's level for the tier, as the page read it. A man a strike never fells today, or fells by bar hits (a Sarge with a blade up, the riot shield, the snowball bouncers), keeps that rule.
